metadata.coverage_preamble: The day holds the yard, the two looks at it, Alleyn at the door, and the page you wrote after.

yesterday: The afternoon was the Rose, at a penny.
The laugh starts at the stride. Attention comes back when the staff stops. You wrote that down.
The bad sentence is still on the page. Alleyn was cordial.
Tomorrow you are in the gentlemen, and there is a reckoning after.
